title: DJIA Market Happenings For Thursday, May 31, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Thursday, May 31, 2018 Posted by admin on May 31st, Intel (INTC) and Microsoft down -29 points.
Wednesday the Dow was up +306.33 (+1.26%) at 24,667.78.
 0.21%.
There were 27 Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Exxon Mobil (XOM) +3.93% and Chevron (CVX) +3.11%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Cisco (CSCO) -0.28% and Apple (AAPL) -0.21%.
Unemployment insurance weekly claims in the week ending May 26, the advance figure for seasonally adjusted initial claims was 221,000, a decrease of 13,000 from the previous week’s unrevised level of 234,000. The 4-week moving average was 222,250, an increase of 2,500 from the previous week’s unrevised average of 219,750. Claims taking procedures in Puerto Rico and in the Virgin Islands have still not returned to normal. The advance seasonally adjusted insured unemployment rate was 1.2 percent for the week ending May 19, unchanged from the previous week’s unrevised rate. The advance number for seasonally adjusted insured unemployment during the week ending May 19 was 1,726,000, a decrease of 16,000 from the previous week’s revised level. The previous week’s level was revised up 1,000 from 1,741,000 to 1,742,000. The 4-week moving average was 1,743,500, a decrease of 8,500 from the previous week’s revised average. This is the lowest level for this average since December 15, 1973 when it was 1,735,750. The previous week’s average was revised up by 250 from 1,751,750 to 1,752,000.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended higher.
